comment: Capability acquisition sources (Tier 1 of the ladder). Harness-owned — put YOUR additions/overrides in sources.local.json (merged by name; set "disabled": true there to hide a shipped entry). Machine-queryable sources have queryUrl ({query} placeholder) + parser; the rest are pointers for web-capable agents. Trust tiers: official > curated > community.

sources.name: skills.sh
sources.searchHint: Browse/search the registry; install with: npx skills add <owner>/<repo> — then ADAPT the skill (see capability-acquisition.md), don't use as-is.

sources.name: github-skills-topic
sources.searchHint: GitHub repos tagged agent-skills. GITHUB_TOKEN env raises the rate limit.

sources.name: mattpocock-skills
sources.searchHint: Engineering craft skills (MIT). Several are already vendored in harness/skills/.

sources.name: github-skillmd-code-search
sources.searchHint: Code-search for SKILL.md files mentioning your topic: path:SKILL.md <keyword>.

sources.name: mcp-reference-servers
sources.searchHint: Reference servers (filesystem, fetch, git, memory, ...) + a long community list in the README.

sources.name: npm-mcp
sources.searchHint: npm packages named mcp-server-*. Check weekly downloads + maintenance before trusting.

sources.name: glama-mcp
sources.searchHint: MCP server directory with health/quality signals.

sources.name: pypi-exact
sources.searchHint: PyPI exact-name lookup (PyPI has no public JSON search — query with the exact package name; browse pypi.org for discovery).

sources.name: github-tools
sources.searchHint: GitHub repo search. GITHUB_TOKEN env raises the rate limit.
